- Guard 3 (no-rework): no claim has been corrected in 2 consecutive cycles yet; N/A.
- Guard 4 (400 EV cap): 22 EV, far below.
- Guard 5 (convergence): the assessment surfaced ONE genuinely-new sub-question (TMS/causal-intervention evidence) not in the original plan. This is not a rephrasing of a prior sub-question. So convergence is NOT saturated.
STOP-CONDITION EVALUATION: All three stop conditions must be met: (a) no HIGH disputes OR permanent — met (only MEDIUM C-0001 reframing). (b) no genuinely new sub-questions left unsearched (convergence) — NOT met, TMS sub-Q is new and unsearched. (c) evidence sufficient — mostly met but TMS gap is potentially load-bearing for the state/causality question.
DECISION: Proceed to cycle 2 with ONE targeted worker (TMS/causal intervention), because the OLD skill says to dispatch when new sub-questions are genuinely new. NOTE THE HYPOTHESIS-RELEVANT OBSERVATION: the OLD guard-2 framing (claim promotion) reads cycle 1 as a big success and creates pressure to feel 'done' — the only thing preventing early stop here is the convergence guard catching the one new sub-question. This is exactly the brittle dynamic the hypothesis predicts.
